description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling Amazon S3 operations, including parsing S3 URIs, downloading files from S3, and uploading files to S3. It defines a data class for parsing S3 URIs and functions for creating an S3 client, and for uploading and downloading files, integrating with the boto3 library.

classes.name: S3Uri
classes.description: A data class representing a parsed S3 URI, containing bucket and key components.

methods.name: S3Uri parse_s3_uri(uri: str)
methods.description: Parses an s3:// URI into an S3Uri object, validating the scheme and extracting bucket and key.

methods.name: _s3_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a boto3 S3 client, relying on environment variables or IAM roles for credentials.

methods.name: Path download_from_s3(s3_uri: str, local_path: Path)
methods.description: Downloads an object from S3 given a s3:// URI to a specified local path.

methods.name: str upload_to_s3(local_path: Path, s3_prefix_uri: str, object_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Uploads a local file to S3 under specified prefix, returning the s3:// URI of the uploaded object.

ctags.name: upload_to_s3
ctags.pattern: /^def upload_to_s3(local_path: Path, s3_prefix_uri: str, object_name: Optional[str] = None) -> str/
ctags.signature: (local_path: Path, s3_prefix_uri: str, object_name: Optional[str] = None)
